method: Second pass by maker. analog.com (503), mouser.com, digikey.com, farnell / newark, arrow, rutronik24, future, microchipdirect, octopart and trustedparts all refused page reads; TME, LCSC and findchips return no product list without scripts. ADI parts therefore come from WebSearch result titles and summaries of franchised-distributor listings (Digi-Key, Mouser, Newark, Arrow) - each note says exactly what was read; aecq is true only where the words AEC-Q100 were read. Microchip parts come from PDFs read in full on ww1.microchip.com (Microchip's document server, which answered): nine data sheets / one user guide with the orderable codes printed, and three selector guides - 'Automotive Product Selector Guide' DS00003019A (Aug 2019), 'Analog and Interface Product Selector Guide' DS20001060AW (June 2020), '32-bit Automotive MCUs' DS60001427D (June 2019) - which confirm the automotive line at family level without orderable codes. 15 searches, 36 page reads (13 refused or empty). No prices recorded.
